notes.title: The Doll's Window Puzzles Guide
notes.content:
Thank you for playing The Doll's Window.


 Today, I uploaded an official walkthrough for puzzles in the Guides section.

notes.title: The Doll's Window announcement
notes.content:
Thank you for playing The Doll's Window.
Today, I would clarify some details in the game.


 The flickering of the screen in the area below is intentional.  
 The screen flashes, along with the red tints, reflect Alva's emotional state.  
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42917900/26eb41cfc616e739bd33e747ee4a34e8f4ce06d9.png

However, this effect might cause strain to the eyes during extended gameplay.
To lessen the discomfort of longtime playing, I provided the solution to the puzzle in this area below.[spoiler]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42917900/05e032fed50fd623915e2cef8025ecf7227b812f.png[/spoiler]

 [spoiler]Make sure to grab the key that's in a room right before this map.[/spoiler]
 [spoiler]Avoid walking on the areas highlighted in pink.[/spoiler]
 [spoiler]Make sure to grab the key, noted as a blue square on this map, before progressing.[/spoiler]
 
I hope you'll continue to enjoy The Doll's Window.

notes.title: The Doll's Window update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing The Doll's Window.
Today, I have adjusted some minor details in the game.


 Added an additional hint for the 'magic words' puzzle.
 You can now view the hint at the bookcase room that's located just before the said puzzle. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42917900/62ced16b527e1d8d852274272ee72a2aa6f74b2d.png

I hope you'll continue to enjoy The Doll's Window.
